source.comparison_anchor_policy: calendar windows are anchored to the evaluation date; each source uses the last available snapshot at or before the cutoff

replacement_context.method: position-specific lower-boundary proxy from current league-owned normalized family percentiles
replacement_context.policy: family percentiles remain separate; dynasty market, redraft ADP and season projections are not averaged into one player value

population.selection_rule: all current fantasy free agents QB/RB/WR/TE/K are evaluated; only research-relevant movement discoveries are emitted

activity.policy: activity is corroboration/research context, not a discovery prerequisite or player-quality score
